points.description: First challenge of mobile routing is named and described in any wording (e.g. adaptation to topology changes, security, medium access/hidden-exposed terminal, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, power consumption), with the central idea of why it is harder than in fixed wired networks.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only named without description, or described vaguely without naming.

points.description: A second, different challenge from the model answer list is named and described in any wording, with its central idea.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only named without description, or described vaguely without naming.

rubric.notes: Full marks for two distinct valid challenges (any from the model answer list), each with a name and a brief description in any wording. Give part marks for a challenge that is only named or only vaguely described, or if just one challenge is given well. No marks for challenges that are not mobile/wireless-specific (e.g. generic ones that also apply to wired networks) or for repeating the same challenge twice.
